title: toast no redundant dismiss
name: Toast no redundant dismiss — Spectrum
rule: No redundant Dismiss — every toast already has a close control.
pass_when: No extra Dismiss action besides the toast close control.
fail_when: A Dismiss button in addition to the close control.
overview: Toasts already have a close control; do not add a redundant Dismiss action.
apply_when: Authoring toast actions alongside the built-in close control.
not_when: Dialogs or banners whose primary recovery action is a labeled dismiss.
agent_hint: Omit extra Dismiss buttons; the toast close control is enough.
description: Every Spectrum toast already includes a close control, so an extra Dismiss action is redundant noise. A second dismiss control clutters the toast and competes with any single related action the pattern allows. Keep the built-in close for dismissal; reserve the optional action slot for a task related to the toast text, not another way to hide the message.
do_not_claim: That the close control may be omitted.
